# The Cradle Merch

> > Official merchandise store for The Cradle featuring apparel, accessories, and resistance-themed products with Arabic calligraphy designs.

The Cradle Merch offers a curated collection of clothing and accessories including hoodies, t-shirts, tote bags, and mugs. The store features distinctive designs incorporating Arabic calligraphy and resistance themes, serving supporters of The Cradle media platform.
